name: Barracudas & needlefish
description: Barracudas, needlefish and cutlassfish - the source's 'Barracudas +' compartment: Sphyraena barracudas, Tylosurus and Strongylura needlefish, a halfbeak (Hemiramphus) and the cutlassfish Trichiurus lepturus - the sleek open-water hunters of the bolong. Their diet leans heavily on ethmalose (bonga shad) and shrimps. The study uses them as its worked example of a fishery-targeted group whose increase ripples through the whole web. Functional group pooling the source's Barracudas + compartment.
